symptoms.title: Clicking Share shows no screen or window picker
symptoms.explanation: The picker is drawn by the portal backend, so when it never appears the request did not get that far: the portal is not reachable, cannot start, has no backend for ScreenCast, or the backend cannot reach the compositor.

symptoms.title: The picker works, but viewers see a black or frozen frame
symptoms.explanation: Choosing a screen worked, so the portal and its backend answered; the frame travels from the compositor through PipeWire to the app, and one of those links is missing or the app reads it the wrong way.

symptoms.title: The window I want is not offered
symptoms.explanation: The list of windows comes from the portal backend and the compositor. Some backends offer whole screens only, and apps running through XWayland may only see X11 windows.

symptoms.title: The app says screen sharing was denied or is not allowed
symptoms.explanation: A denial comes from the portal: the request was cancelled, the backend refused it, or no backend answered and the app reports that as a denial.
limitations: The portal's permission store and Flatpak permissions are not read by this version.

symptoms.title: Only some apps' windows can be shared
symptoms.explanation: On Wayland every window is offered by the compositor through the portal; an app that only lists some windows usually runs through XWayland and looks for X11 windows itself.
